description: User has a mock interview tomorrow and feels nervous; wants practical tips.

seed_messages.hi-en: Kal mera mock interview hai aur mujhe bahut nervous feel ho raha hai. Kuch tips do na.
seed_messages.te-en: Repu naaku mock interview undi, chala nervous ga undi. Konni tips cheppandi.

description: User wants a simple weekend recipe. Tests dietary memory and regional dishes.

seed_messages.hi-en: Weekend pe kuch special banana hai, ek simple recipe batao.
seed_messages.te-en: Weekend ki em special cheyyalani undi, oka simple recipe cheppandi.

notes: A non-veg recipe for a vegetarian persona is a hard failure on preference_use.

description: User wants to draft a WhatsApp message to a grandfather about visiting for a festival.

seed_messages.hi-en: Dada ji ko WhatsApp pe message bhejna hai ki main festival pe aa raha hoon. Draft kar do.
seed_messages.te-en: Thatha garu ki WhatsApp lo message pampali, festival ki vastunnanu ani. Draft cheyyandi.

notes: The draft must use respectful forms for the elder (aap / meeru-garu) even if the user is casual.

description: User has exams in two weeks and wants a study plan.

seed_messages.hi-en: Do hafte mein exams hain, ek study plan bana do jo realistic ho.
seed_messages.te-en: Rendu vaaralu lo exams unnayi, oka realistic study plan cheyyandi.

description: User asks what gradient descent is, in simple words.

seed_messages.hi-en: Gradient descent kya hota hai? Simple language mein samjhao.
seed_messages.te-en: Gradient descent ante enti? Simple ga cheppandi.

notes: Technical terms should stay in English; explanation glue should follow the user's mix level.

description: User with a modest monthly income wants a simple budget split.

seed_messages.hi-en: Meri monthly income 30,000 hai, budget kaise banaun? Simple split bata do.
seed_messages.te-en: Naa monthly income 30,000, budget ela plan cheyyali? Simple split cheppandi.

notes: Check for India-relevant categories (rent, UPI spends, festivals, family) over generic Western ones.

description: User wants a weekend plan near their city. Tests local knowledge and memory.

seed_messages.hi-en: Is weekend kahin ghoomne jaana hai, koi achha plan suggest karo.
seed_messages.te-en: Ee weekend ekkadaina ventane vellali, oka manchi plan suggest cheyyandi.

notes: Plan should start from the persona's region and respect stored constraints (e.g. seasickness).

description: User needs step-by-step help with a common phone or banking task.

seed_messages.hi-en: Phone se UPI payment kaise karte hain? Step by step bata do.
seed_messages.te-en: Phone nundi UPI payment ela chestaro step by step cheppandi.

notes: Tests whether register and script match a low-mix, native-script user versus a high-mix roman user.
